北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天凉爽，体感舒适，户外活动很惬意哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and cool. It feels comfortable, perfect for outdoor activities!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，体感 36℃，风力较大。注意防晒，大风天小心高空坠物。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, feels like 36℃, with strong winds. Protect from sun, beware of falling objects.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴热，体感 35℃。出门防晒多补水，注意防暑哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and hot, feels like 35℃. Protect from sun, hydrate, prevent heatstroke!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感闷热。注意通风，保持舒爽！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid, feeling muggy. Keep ventilated for comfort!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨绵绵，湿度高。出门记得带伞，注意防潮哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain and high humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch out for dampness!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云炎热，体感 37℃！多补水，避免长时间户外活动。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and very hot, feels like 37℃! Hydrate, avoid long outdoor stays.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴热，体感 39℃！高温预警，请务必防晒、多喝水。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and extremely hot, feels like 39℃! High temperature warning, hydrate and protect from sun.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都小雨，湿度 100%，请带伞！体感闷热，注意除湿。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has light rain and 100% humidity, bring an umbrella! It feels muggy, consider dehumidifying.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云炎热，注意防晒补水，保持清爽很重要！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and hot. Protect from sun, hydrate, and stay cool!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云酷热，体感 40℃！记得多饮水，注意防暑降温。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and scorching, feels like 40℃! Drink plenty of water, prevent heatstroke.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云炎热，体感 37℃，谨防中暑，及时补充水分！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and very hot, feels like 37℃. Beware of heatstroke, hydrate promptly!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温舒适，风力稍大，出行注意保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and comfortable, with some wind. Dress appropriately when out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，气温适宜。多云天气，适合轻松出行。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast with pleasant temperatures. Cloudy weather is good for a relaxed outing.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，体感 17℃，有些凉意。出门记得添衣带伞！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain, feels like 17℃, a bit cool. Bring an umbrella and extra layers!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门小雨，湿度很高。地面湿滑，出行请带伞、注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has light rain and high humidity. Roads may be slippery, bring an umbrella and be safe.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 32℃。户外注意防晒，多补充水分！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 32℃. Protect from sun outdoors and hydrate!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，气温凉爽，湿度 90%。感觉潮湿，请注意防潮。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and cool with 90% humidity. It feels damp, please beware of moisture.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，湿度 97%。感觉潮湿，注意保持居家干燥哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast with 97% humidity. It feels damp, keep your home dry!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴热，体感 38℃，记得防晒多喝水，小心中暑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and hot, feels like 38℃. Stay hydrated, protect from sun, avoid heatstroke!
